udt_error_enum_v0.doc: Every failure mode is an explicit, contiguous `u32` so the TypeScript client\ncan map a contract error straight to a user-facing message without guessing.
udt_error_enum_v0.name: Error

cases.doc: No vault has been opened for this parent yet.
cases.name: VaultNotFound

cases.doc: Allocating this allowance would exceed the parent's deposited balance.
cases.name: InsufficientUnallocated

cases.doc: The recipient tried to claim more than their current allowance.

cases.name: InsufficientBalance

udt_union_v0.doc:
Storage keys.

`Admin`, `Token` and `Paused` are configuration and live in *instance*
storage so they share the contract instance's TTL. `Vault` and `Allowance`
hold user funds/claims and live in *persistent* storage so they outlive the
instance and are never garbage-collected out from under a pending claim.
udt_union_v0.name: DataKey

udt_struct_v0.doc:
The on-chain state of one parent's family vault.

`balance` is the total XLM the parent has deposited and the contract still
custodies for them. `allocated` is the sum of all outstanding per-recipient
allowances. The parent may freely withdraw `balance - allocated` (the
*unallocated* remainder); the allocated portion is reserved for recipients
to claim.
udt_struct_v0.name: Vault

fields.doc: Sum of all live per-recipient allowances under this parent.
fields.name: allocated

fields.doc: Total deposited XLM still held in escrow for this parent (minor units).
fields.name: balance

function_v0.doc: One-time setup. Records the admin and the escrowed token (the native XLM\nSAC on Tabungan), and unpauses the contract.
function_v0.name: initialize

function_v0.doc:
Parent deposits `amount` of the vault token into their family vault.
Returns the new total vault balance.

Auth: the parent's signature, which also covers the inner SAC
`transfer(parent -> contract)`.
function_v0.name: deposit

function_v0.doc:
Parent sets the **absolute** allowance a `recipient` can claim. Passing a
smaller value lowers it; passing `0` clears it. The total of all
allowances may never exceed the parent's deposited balance.
Returns the parent's unallocated (still-withdrawable) balance.

Auth: the parent's signature.
function_v0.name: set_allowance

function_v0.doc:
Recipient claims `amount` from the allowance `parent` set for them. The
contract pays out from its own balance. Returns the recipient's remaining
allowance.

Auth: the recipient's signature \xe2\x80\x94 binds the payout to them.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc:
Parent withdraws `amount` of the **unallocated** balance back to their
wallet. Allocated allowances stay reserved for recipients. Returns the
new total vault balance.

Auth: the parent's signature.
function_v0.name: withdraw_unallocated

function_v0.doc: The parent's vault (balance + allocated). Returns a zeroed vault if the\nparent has never deposited, so the UI can render an empty state.
function_v0.name: get_vault

function_v0.doc: The unallocated (withdrawable) portion of a parent's vault.
function_v0.name: unallocated

function_v0.doc: The current claimable allowance for a (parent, recipient) pair.
function_v0.name: get_allowance

function_v0.doc: Replace the contract's own Wasm (admin-gated). Lets us ship fixes without\nmigrating vault state \xe2\x80\x94 important for a future mainnet deploy.
function_v0.name: upgrade
